ai_summary: Ashapura Minechem Ltd. has declared a final dividend of Rs. 2.00/share for FY26, which will now be subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under the new provisions of the Income Tax Act, 2025 (amended by Finance Act, 2026). This change materially impacts shareholders' net dividend receipts, requiring them to update KYC details and submit specific tax exemption or DTAA documentation by September 22, 2026. A key warning is that the company will apply higher TDS rates for incomplete submissions without further communication, placing the burden on shareholders to pursue any eligible refunds.
